messages:
Eve: opening war room — eu-west hosted inference is seeing intermittent 502/504s and p95 latency spikes since ~08:10 UTC. Customer escalations incoming. :rotating_light:
Ben: seeing same in metrics, backend connection resets between gateway and model-pool. Rolling error rate ~8% at peak.
Alice: +1, connections showing RST from NLB -> backend (tcp close). No obvious pod OOMs.
Carla: support queue: 3 customers hit with timeouts, one high-visibility PLG customer asked for ETA. I told them we're triaging.
Eve: immediate mitigation idea — shift traffic off eu-west2 model pool to eu-west1 fallback. Ben, can we route?
Ben: can do quick traffic cut if we enable fallback routing policy. Doing canary drain to eu-west1 now.
infra-bot: action: route_update started by Ben at 08:25 UTC (id: rte-6532).
Carla: customer A confirms partial improvement after 08:35 UTC, still some 504s for longer requests.
Alice: logs show backend keepalive timeouts: NLB idle_timeout was recently lowered to 60s during config change this morning. Runtime keeps long-lived connections for streaming and KV cache, so mismatch can produce EPIPE/resets.
Ben: yep, we see nginx upstream read errors and 'write: broken pipe' in runtime logs. Patch idea: increase NLB idle_timeout to 400s and add TCP keepalive at proxy layer.
Dan: is rollback of the morning NLB change an option or faster to bump timeout? Need to pick low-risk path for customers.
Eve: bumping idle timeout seems least invasive. Ben/Alice — please coordinate with infra to flip to 400s.
Alice: pinging infra infra-team @here — can we change NLB idle_timeout for the eu-west LB now?
infra-bot: infra-notify: NLB config change requires a short reconnection window. Scheduling change at 08:50 UTC.
Carla: drafting customer update: "We've identified a networking idle timeout mismatch causing resets; we're applying a configuration change now and monitoring." Review?
Dan: LGTM, call out impacted time window and that we're routing fallback traffic. Keep it concise.
Ben: applied keepalive + runtime config tweak at 08:52 UTC (increase connection retry). Monitoring ingress -> model latency and 5xx.
Alice: infra confirms NLB idle_timeout increased to 400s at 08:54 UTC. Early metrics show error rate dropping from 8% -> 1.2% over 15m.
Carla: customers acknowledging improved behavior, thanks. :thumbsup:
Eve: Great. We'll keep channel open for postmortem follow-up items. Who wants to own?
Ben: I can own the postmortem and action items. Will draft root cause and timeline.
Alice: I'll add infra-side remediation: revert overly aggressive NLB template change in terraform and add gating checks.
Dan: product asks for customer-facing summary and a compensation/credits recommendation for impacted customers. Will coordinate with finance.
Carla: I'll prepare a summary template and customer comms.
Ben: quick repro notes for the postmortem: 
```
# repro (dev):
# - create long-lived streaming request (>120s) to hosted endpoint behind NLB with idle_timeout=60
# - run many concurrent clients to build open connection count
# curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"stream test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# observe: gateway nginx logs with "upstream prematurely closed connection" and runtime showing EPIPE
```
Alice: logs/graphs to attach: tcpdump traces, nginx upstream_error logs, LB change deployment timestamp from deploy system.
Ben: planned action items (will create GH issues): [1] revert NLB template change + add terraform test, [2] add LB idle_timeout alert, [3] add proxy keepalive config to runtime defaults, [4] run e2e long-connection test during infra deploys, [5] customer comms & credits proposal.
Eve: add owner and due dates. Ben, can you propose assignees and ETA by EOD?
Ben: yes, will assign by 17:00 UTC and include PR links.
Carla: postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause, detection, mitigation, customer impact, action items, severity classification. I'll help format.
Alice: small ops note — autoscaler also showed delayed scale up for model-pool because reconcile loop hit API throttling at same time; low likelihood root cause but add to follow-ups.
Dan: good capture.
Eve: closing war room for active mitigation — we'll keep thread for follow-ups and postmortem draft. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
